title: Overview
description: A high-level introduction to the Requests library, its purpose, key features, and a simple usage example to get started.

title: Getting Started
description: Provides simple, step-by-step instructions for installing the library and making your first HTTP request.

title: User Guide
description: Explore the core functionalities of Requests through practical, code-first examples covering common use cases.

title: Making a Request
description: Learn how to use various HTTP methods like GET, POST, PUT, and how to pass URL parameters, headers, and request bodies.

title: Handling Responses
description: Understand how to access response content (text, JSON, binary), check status codes, and read response headers.

title: Session Objects
description: Utilize Session objects to persist parameters, cookies, and headers across multiple requests for improved performance and state management.

title: Authentication
description: Implement various authentication schemes, including Basic and Digest Auth, to secure your requests.

title: Error Handling
description: Learn to anticipate and handle potential request errors, such as connection issues, timeouts, and bad HTTP statuses.

title: Advanced Usage
description: Dive deeper into advanced features for handling complex scenarios like custom timeouts, proxies, SSL verification, and more.

title: Timeouts, Retries, and Proxies
description: Configure network behavior by setting request timeouts, automatic retries for failed connections, and routing requests through proxies.

title: SSL Certificate Verification
description: Manage SSL/TLS verification by using custom CA bundles, client-side certificates, or disabling verification for specific cases.

title: Custom Adapters and Hooks
description: Extend the functionality of Requests by creating custom Transport Adapters and using the event hook system.

title: API Reference
description: A detailed and comprehensive reference for all public classes, methods, and functions in the Requests library.

title: Community
description: Information on the project's history, contributors, and how to get involved with the Requests community.

title: Changelog
description: A detailed log of all changes, improvements, and bug fixes for each version of the Requests library.

title: Contributors
description: A list of all the individuals who have contributed to the development of the Requests library.
